title: Offline Language-Based Support System for Tactical Decision-Making in Air Combat Operations
abstract: arXiv:2610.35635v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An offline language-based support tool is presented to assist pilot training and tactical decision-making in air combat operations. The system, named MATE (Mission Assistant for Training and Evaluation), applies retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to answer natural language questions using content extracted from doctrinal and tactical manuals. Built entirely with open-source components, it performs text preprocessing, embedding generation, semantic search, and language generation locally, ensuring full offline functionality. The tool was evaluated by three Brazilian Air Force fighter pilots, who rated the answers produced with three open-weight language models (Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen 2.5 14B, and Mistral NeMo 12B) to five tactical questions derived from a publicly available air combat manual. translated_title: 面向空战作战战术决策的离线语言支持系统
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种离线的基于语言的支持工具，用于辅助空战作战中的飞行员训练和战术决策。该系统名为MATE（训练与评估任务助手），应用检索增强生成（RAG）技术，利用从条令和战术手册中提取的内容来回答自然语言问题。该系统完全由开源组件构建，可在本地执行文本预处理、嵌入生成、语义搜索和语言生成，确保完全离线运行。该工具由三名巴西空军战斗机飞行员进行评估，他们对三个开源权重语言模型（Llama 3.1 8B、Qwen 2.5 14B和Mistral NeMo 12B）针对源自公开空战手册的五个战术问题所生成的回答进行了评分。五分制下的平均评分为4.00至4.40分，其中Mistral NeMo 12B获得最高分。（注：原摘要末尾内容被截断）
tldr: 本文提出了完全离线、基于开源组件和检索增强生成（RAG）技术的语言支持系统MATE，通过战术手册内容回答自然语言问题以辅助空战飞行员训练与战术决策，并经巴西空军飞行员评估获得4.00至4.40的高评分。
en_tdlr: This paper presents MATE, a fully offline, open-source RAG-based language support system that answers natural language questions from tactical manuals to assist pilot training and tactical decision-making in air combat, achieving high ratings of 4.00 to 4.40 out of 5 from Brazilian Air Force fighter pilots.
